display.label: Private Endpoint
display.description: Azure Private Endpoint providing secure private IP connectivity from a VNet subnet to Azure and Private Link services

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Private Endpoint. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Private Endpoint identity and network placement settings.

fields.label: Private Endpoint Name
fields.description: Name of the Azure Private Endpoint. Must be between 1 and 80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

validation.pattern_error: Private Endpoint name must be between 1 and 80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Private Endpoint.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Private Endpoint should be created.

fields.label: Subnet Resource ID
fields.description: The full Azure resource ID of the Subnet from which the private IP will be allocated.

fields.label: Custom Network Interface Name
fields.description: Optional custom name for the network interface automatically created by Azure for this Private Endpoint.

sections.label: Private Service Connection
sections.description: Target service configuration for the Azure Private Link connection.

fields.label: Service Connection Configuration
fields.description: Configuration details for the Private Service Connection.

fields.label: Connection Name
fields.description: Name of the Private Service Connection.

fields.label: Target Resource ID
fields.description: The Azure resource ID of the target resource (e.g. Storage Account, Key Vault, Azure SQL). Specify either this or Service Alias.

fields.label: Private Link Service Alias
fields.description: The alias of the target Private Link Service. Specify either this or Target Resource ID.

fields.label: Subresource Names
fields.description: A list of subresource names to which the Private Endpoint connects (e.g., ['blob'] for Storage, ['vault'] for Key Vault, ['sqlServer'] for SQL).

fields.label: Manual Approval Connection
fields.description: Set to true if this connection requires manual approval from the target resource owner.

fields.label: Approval Request Message
fields.description: Optional message sent with the request when manual connection approval is required.
fields.placeholder: Requesting private endpoint connection for application workload

sections.label: Private DNS Zone Integration
sections.description: Associate Private DNS Zones to automatically resolve the service private IP.

fields.label: Private DNS Zone Group
fields.description: Private DNS Zone Group settings.

fields.label: DNS Zone Group Name
fields.description: Name of the Private DNS Zone Group.

fields.label: Private DNS Zone IDs
fields.description: List of Private DNS Zone resource IDs to associate with this Private Endpoint.

sections.label: Static Private IP Allocations
sections.description: Assign specific static private IP addresses from the subnet to the Private Endpoint.

fields.label: IP Configurations
fields.description: List of static IP configuration blocks for the Private Endpoint.

fields.label: Configuration Name
fields.description: Name of this IP configuration entry.

fields.label: Static Private IP Address
fields.description: The static IPv4 address within the subnet to allocate to this Private Endpoint.

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.1.10).

fields.label: Subresource Name
fields.description: The subresource name this static IP applies to (e.g. 'blob').

fields.label: Member Name
fields.description: The member name this static IP applies to (e.g. 'blob').

sections.label: Tagging
sections.description: Resource tags for governance, categorization, and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to assign to the Private Endpoint.
